tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities that have published weekends, with their slug, IATA airport code, currency and the twelve monthly season factors (1.0 = shoulder season; higher is dearer). Paged.

tools.name: get_city
tools.description: Fetch one city by its slug (from list_cities): name, country, region, coordinates, IATA code, currency and the twelve monthly season factors.

tools.name: list_personas
tools.description: List the personas (the kind of traveller an itinerary is written for, e.g. foodie or collector) with their slug and audience: party_shapes (solo, couple, friends, family, multigen), children (boolean) and pace (relaxed, steady, brisk). Persona slugs are used with city slugs to name an itinerary. Pag

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Fetch one persona by its slug (from list_personas), with its audience.

tools.name: list_origins
tools.description: List the origins a trip can start from: slug (the origin parameter), name and IATA airport code. Unpaged.

tools.name: list_pricing_tiers
tools.description: List the budget tiers in display order (cheap, modest, expensive, luxury, ultra); the name is the tier parameter's value.

tools.name: list_pricing_multipliers
tools.description: List every price multiplier: for each (tier, dimension) the factor applied to the modest-tier price. Dimensions are sight, culture, dining, lodging, transport and flight.

tools.name: list_published_itineraries
tools.description: The public index: every published itinerary with its city and persona slugs, title, summary, names, step counts and the sum of its steps' costs in integer cents (currency EUR unless the city says otherwise). It lists every (city, persona) weekend that exists.

tools.name: get_published_itinerary
tools.description: The full published itinerary for one (city, persona): its days and steps with local times (HH:MM), kind, notes, cost_cents per person at the modest tier (integer cents), reserve_days (how many days ahead a hard step must be booked, or null), a fallback, and each step's venue with coordinates and off

tools.name: itinerary_calendar
tools.description: The published itinerary as iCalendar text for one weekend (Friday = day 0): one event per step at floating local times, no time zone. friday is a YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: estimate_itinerary
tools.description: Budget estimate (integer cents) for a published itinerary: activities, lodging, transport and flights for a tier, a month or the year average, and a group.

tools.name: estimate_all
tools.description: Compare published weekends by price (integer cents) for a tier, a month or the year average, a group and an optional origin. By default (detail cities) one row per city: its cheapest persona, min_total_cents and min_per_person_cents. detail all adds a row per (city, persona) with total, per person,

tools.name: get_fare
tools.description: Cheapest known return fare per person between two IATA codes for a Friday-to-Monday weekend (cached from Travelpayouts).

tools.name: booking_checklist
tools.description: Booking links and checklist for a weekend, ordered by scarcity: first the steps that must be booked ahead (longest lead time first, each with reserve_days, a book_by date YYYY-MM-DD and an easier fallback), then flights, the hotel and the other bookable steps. An item's alternatives [{provider, url}

tools.name: booking_manifest
tools.description: The booking plan for one weekend, in booking order: items (flights, hotel and bookable steps; scarcest first) each with kind, title, when (date YYYY-MM-DD and local time HH:MM), the affiliate-tracked partner url with dates, party size and time prefilled where the partner supports it, provider, estim

tools.name: submit_tip
tools.description: Send a tip about a city: a place to add, a closed place, somewhere nearly impossible to book, or a wrong fact. Public. A tip is never published; an editor reviews it first. Rate limited per sender.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_cities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Paged." → after: "List the cities that have published weekends, with their slug, IATA airport code, currency and the twelve monthly season factors (1.0 = shoulder season; higher is dearer). Paged."
